name: Daily-paid holidays in late December
about: ₱800 a day, Dec 16–31. Christmas (regular) is paid unworked because Dec 23 was worked (Dec 24 is a special day off, so it is skipped). Rizal Day is not paid because Dec 29 was an absence. Dec 31 (special) is worked at the full 130%. Daily-paid absences are simply unpaid.
workings: Daily rate: as given = 800.000000; hourly 100.000000; per minute 1.666667
HOLIDAY_PAY 800.00: Dec 25 unworked regular holiday at 100%
SSS -437.50: MSC 17,500.00 × 5% = 875.00 a month; the rest after the first cutoff's half
PHILHEALTH -217.50: premium 5% × 17,400.00 = 870.00; employee half 435.00; the rest after the first cutoff's half
